PZZ700-101000-
101 PM PST Mon Nov 9 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1023 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of San Diego,
a 1022 mb high covered Utah, and a 1015 mb low covered the inner 
coastal waters. Northeast offshore flow during nights and mornings
will alternate with northwest onshore flow during afternoons and 
evenings through Thursday. Onshore winds pick up Friday as a
weather system approaches to the south.
